extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent discussed plan benefits before delivering the disclaimer, which is non-compliant. The agent also scheduled the appointment immediately after sending the Scope of Appointment, which is compliant.
composition.coaching_note: Marcus, it's important to ensure the disclaimer is delivered before discussing any benefits. This call should be reviewed to ensure compliance with the rules. Next time, make sure to deliver the disclaimer first, even if the customer is eager to proceed.
